strings: Crossing the River Anduin under a blanket of darkness...�
an Orc scouting force begins Sauron's renewed assault upon our world.�
The Orc onslaught will be launched at midnight.�
Striking like a dagger at the heart of Osgiliath.�
The most deadly blow shall be struck by an elite horde...�
lying in wait upon the far shore.�
Their siege machines are poised to rain fire down upon the hated Rangers.�
The Orcs await signals from hidden scouts, to identify their targets.�
For those dark hearts wish greatly to see Osgiliath burn.�
